scope: Exact subsets of completed artifacts used by every plot, numeric caption and protocol claim; no fitting or bootstrap recomputation.

readout.primary_endpoint: Final physical-token attention MACCS macro AUROC
readout.secondary_endpoints: Mean-token linear control, functional groups, elements, and per-concept metrics
readout.ensemble: Mean of three seed logits before AUROC; separately report mean of three seed metrics. No test-selected seed.
readout.support_policy: Same fixed targets for all encoders/readouts: at least5 positives and5 negatives in train AND test. Exact half-credit for tied scores.
readout.bootstrap_policy: Shared multinomial molecule counts across all three encoders, both readouts and all seeds. A macro replicate is undefined if any fixed target loses a class; omit the entire group replicate and report its count. Targets never vary across bootstrap replicates.
readout.uncertainty_scope: Conditional on three fixed pretrained checkpoints and fitted readouts. Descriptive unadjusted percentile intervals; no p-values, no pretraining-run uncertainty, no upstream-exposure claim.
readout.causal_scope: Checkpoint comparison, not an isolated training-objective experiment. Training duration, initialization, optimization and native input quantization can differ; molecular labels and downstream panel/readout budgets are shared.
readout.score_losses: Balanced BCE/Brier use sigmoid scores from class-balanced readouts; they are not calibrated prevalence probabilities.

provenance.scope: Read-only authenticated W&B and generation-pinned GCS provenance audit. No model inference or cloud writes in this audit.

endpoint.selection: Latest numeric retained checkpoint with positive commit timestamp and explicit commit markers; agrees with final W&B step.

objective.target: 2048-way exact cross-entropy for masked m/z bins, intensity conditioned
objective.inference_readout: Frozen clean-input native encoder tokens; diffusion predictor and categorical reconstruction head are not the molecular chemistry readout.

initialization.conclusion: Evidence supports an initially fresh diffusion student, not initialization from parent1190k or periodic1209k.
initialization.source_interpretation: Current training code builds the model and resumes only when its workdir has an existing Orbax checkpoint; fresh pretrain initialization has no encoder checkpoint load. The uploaded train.py routes to this task; full historical module identity is not available.
limits: Starting at zero does not exclude later restarts that resume within the same W&B run.
Configuration inheritance reuses architectural settings, not evidence of inherited weights.

training_exposure.definition: Nominal spectrum presentations = checkpoint global step × configured global batch1024. Initial global-step zero is observed in each run. Accumulation8 is already included in global batch and is not multiplied again.
limitations: Not unique spectra or molecular counts; examples may repeat.
Does not prove identical example ordering, unbroken execution, or equal optimization compute.
Parent/periodic teacher training history is not added to student input presentations.
Periodic1209k is a fresh-student run beginning at0, not19k updates of parent1190k.

input_confounds.diffusion_mz_quantization: Valid peak m/z is mapped to bin midpoint (floor(clipped_mz/width)+0.5)*width before Fourier embedding; width0.48828125 Da. Keep the native transformation for this endpoint.
input_confounds.baseline_mz_quantization: Parent and periodic latent-JEPA configurations do not activate the absorbing-diffusion encoder quantizer.
other_known_differences: Single learned encoder per recipe; equal initial seed does not isolate training-recipe effect
input_confounds.interpretation: A measured endpoint comparison can rank these encoders under the shared panel/readout. It cannot attribute differences causally to the diffusion loss alone.

uploaded_train_py.scope: Exact W&B-uploaded train.py only; no complete historical model source or git commit available.

historical_source.limitation: Only train.py was archived by W&B; current local model/training sources are audited implementation evidence, not a cryptographically complete historical training snapshot.
